judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

S. Srimathy, J.:— This petition has been filed seeking to direct the respondents 4 and 5 to grant adequate police protection based on the representation of the petitioner dated 05.02.2026.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the rival party is not allowing Ramu Thevar vagaira to conduct pooja in the temple and the said vagaira has been conducting the pooja for long years. Hence, the petitioner seeks police protection to enable them to exercise his duties poojariship.

3. The learned counsel for the Intervenor, appearing on behalf of one Karuppaiah had submitted that the HR & CE Department has appointed the fit person to manage the temple. He further submitted that the petitioner is not entitled to claim any Poojariship right.

4. The learned Government Advocate (Criminal Side) submitted that there are two groups involved in the dispute, and all parties are claiming the right to worship of the deity.

5. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court directs respondents 4 and 5 to provide adequate police protection for the conduct of the Maha Sivarathiri Thiruvizha at Arulmigu Sri. Periyanayagi Amman & Karuppar Temple, Thottamangalam Village, Thiruvadanai Taluk, Ramanathapuram District, scheduled to be held from 14.02.2026 to 16.02.2026. This order is confined solely to ensuring peaceful worship during the said festival. The Fit Person appointed by the HR & CE Department shall look after the administration. The petitioner shall be entitled only to the right of worship. As far as Poojariship for this year, the Tahsildar shall conduct enquiry and pass orders.

6. With the above directions, this Writ Petition (Criminal) is disposed of.
